_comment: The [Flame Pillar] blast_damage proof, live through real input (GH#71). Same fixture->Relc->spar->training_yard route as ice_floor_loop (near_flame_pillar instead of near_ice_floor: classes {fire_mage:11}, VERIFIED via the inherits-chain to auto-grant flame_scythe/flare_burst/flame_pillar [fire_mage L10+L11] + frost_bolt/quick_cast/light/flame_jet/mana_shield/invisibility [inherited mage L1/L2/L5] with zero hand-stuffed player_skills -- see the fixture's own _comment). training_yard has ZERO blocked cells (data/arenas.json), so the blast's own geometry is pure Chebyshev-radius math, no LoS complication -- unlike icy_floor's own canonical, this route needs no wall/no_los refusal leg (that pairing is already covered live by combat_walkthrough's flame_bolt/spell_damage no_los proof and by test_combat_sim.gd's flame_pillar-specific refusal block; disclosed rather than re-proven here). Kit order (granted_skills: fire_mage's own L10-then-L11 grants first, then inherited mage grants) -> combat kit flame_scythe, flare_burst, flame_pillar, frost_bolt, flame_jet, invisibility -> hotbar slots 3/4/5/6/7/8 (Attack=1, Dash=2 fixed); flame_pillar is slot 5. Route: pc spawns (2,3), training_dummy_a/b spawn (7,3)/(7,4) (relc_spar's enemies order, inert -- never act). Turn 1 (round 1): Dash first (pool 3->6, AP 4->3) so there's enough pool to close from (2,3) all the way onto (6,3) -- ADJACENT to training_dummy_a, deliberately INSIDE its own future blast radius (the self-hit proof) -- in the same turn the cast happens. Move right x4 to (6,3) (pool 6->2) -> cast flame_pillar on the default target (lowest-hp-then-id enemy at full parity HP -- training_dummy_a, alphabetically first, same default-target precedent as ice_floor_loop) -> radius-1 blast around (7,3) is the 3x3 block x[6,8] y[2,4], no blocked/oob clipping (training_yard has neither in range) -- the exact 9-cell sorted list asserted below, which also happens to contain training_dummy_b (7,4) (the SECOND enemy, adjacent to the target) and the pc's OWN cell (6,3) (the self/ally case) -- all three land in hit_ids, proving friendly fire across enemy+enemy+self in one cast. AP lands at exactly 1 (Dash 1 (4->3) + flame_pillar's EFFECTIVE cost 2 -- base 3, minus 1 for [Quick Cast]'s first-spell-this-turn discount, inherited from mage L1 and still live in this kit -- spends 3 total off MAX_AP 4) and combat.terrain stays empty the whole run (instant damage only, no terrain/status write -- the contrast with icy_floor's own canonical is the point). Damage deltas themselves are NOT asserted exactly (a per-victim hit-chance roll can still miss under this fixture's rng_state, exactly like test_combat_sim.gd's own `<=`-not-`<` discipline for this skill) -- the deterministic proof is the skill_resolved payload (cells + hit_ids) and the real attack_resolved roll each of the three gets. Finish with combat_autoplay (inert 21-HP-class dummies, basic melee attacks only -- the flame_pillar proof is already banked, same low-risk finish ice_floor_loop's own canonical uses) and exit clean.

No terrain, no status -- instant damage only (the contrast with icy_floor's own canonical).
